plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-11 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Agriculture - Natural Resources/Range Management Emphasis (BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Agriculture & Agriculture Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', Natural/Range (Campus) tab, last updated/reviewed July 31, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. The catalog prints Total Credits, BS Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly. Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (16/15/15/15/15/14/16/14) and the plan to 120. The catalog prints the curriculum as ranges (Agriculture Core 36-37 credits; Natural Resources/Range Management Emphasis 21 credits; curriculum 57-58 credits). The map exercises the catalog's options inside those ranges: the 4-credit chemistry pairing CHEM 1010 + CHEM 1015 (the catalog offers three lecture/lab pairings at 4-5 credits), COMM 4240 Technical Writing (one of the catalog's two writing options), and the 3-credit AGSC Major Upper-division Elective row for the emphasis's 'Complete One of the Following (3 Credits)' block (AGSC 4100 Beef Cattle Management or AGSC 4250 Sheep Management). The emphasis's fixed RANG courses are placed by the map as printed. This map places 12 credits of Free Electives in Spring of Year 2 and no major courses that term, exactly as printed. Catalog titles are recorded where the map uses ampersands or shortens them ('Agriculture & Society', 'Feeding & Nutrition of Horses & Livestock', 'Rangeland - Ungulate Animal Relations'). Per the catalog, major requirements must be completed with a grade of 'C-' or better and courses completed over 10 years ago are not accepted toward this degree.
